Binta Traore is a Platform Engineer at AdvertiseSphere Inc., specializing in building scalable systems for real-time ad delivery. With a focus on optimizing infrastructure for high-volume traffic, she drives performance improvements and ensures seamless integration across platforms.  

A results-oriented professional with 3 years of experience in adtech, Binta excels at aligning technical solutions with business goals. Her work has directly contributed to enhancing campaign efficiency and reducing latency in ad-serving processes. She thrives in dynamic environments, leveraging cross-functional collaboration to deliver robust, scalable systems.  

Binta holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science from the University of Bamako, complemented by certifications in cloud computing and data management.  

Platform Engineer | AdvertiseSphere Inc. (2021–Present)  
Designed and deployed high-availability systems supporting millions of daily ad requests. Streamlined workflows to improve deployment cycles by 40%, reducing manual intervention. Partnered with data teams to refine targeting algorithms, boosting campaign ROI by 25%.  

Technical Lead | AdTech Solutions (2018–2021)  
Led infrastructure upgrades for a real-time bidding platform, achieving 99.9% uptime during peak traffic. Introduced automated monitoring tools to proactively address bottlenecks, cutting resolution times by 30%. Collaborated with product teams to integrate new features, accelerating time-to-market.
